item.title: Daily Court Digest: Major environment orders (February 3, 2026)
item.description: The NGT has criticized the NMCG for its inaction regarding an unauthorized railway bridge over the Ganga, demanding accountability by April 23. Additionally, the NGT has requested a detailed groundwater report and formed a committee to investigate illegal sand mining on the Yamuna.

item.title: From global governance talks to bot-only platforms, artificial intelligence races ahead of regulation
item.description: The UN is forming a global panel to guide AI governance amid concerns over misinformation and job disruption, while platforms like Moltbook enable AI agents to interact autonomously, highlighting the rapid evolution of AI beyond current regulations.

item.title: Grazing and digging put some herbivores at greater risk from toxic elements in soil — new research
item.description: Research in South Africa reveals that herbivores like grazers and burrowers ingest more soil, increasing their exposure to toxic elements. This study highlights the importance of understanding soil ingestion patterns to guide conservation efforts and protect vulnerable species from pollutants.
